en: Black-and-white postcard showing a two‑storey wooden building with a tiled gable roof, central porch, and dormer window, surrounded by small trees and a garden. The text at the bottom identifies it as student housing for the Dalsland Folk High School in Färgelanda and credits the photographer O. Lilljeqvist from Dals Långed, with an 'Äkta Fotografi' mark and card number A 89.
